app.title: Names-On-Chain
app.subtitle: A Doichain name registration transaction generator
app.description: Register and trade Doichain names with PSBTs, without a private key in the browser

banner.after: : a PSBT you sign in your wallet spends real DOI. Check every output before you sign.

status.retrying: Server {host} is not reachable, new attempt {attempt}/{max}
status.wrongChain: Server {host} does not follow the valid Doichain chain, trying another one ({attempt}/{max})
status.unverified: Could not check the chain of server {host}, trying another one ({attempt}/{max})
status.offline: No internet connection. The app reconnects once it is back.
status.failed: No Doichain server answered. Check your internet connection and reload the page.
status.offlineHelp: The form opens as soon as a Doichain server on the valid chain answers.

name.label: Name to register
name.notChecked: Not checked yet. The name reaches a server only when you check it.
name.expired: It was registered before and expired at block {expiresAt}, so it can be registered again.

errors.space: A name must not contain spaces.
errors.tooShort: The name "{name}" is too short: names need at least {min} characters.
errors.tooLong: The name is {bytes} bytes long; Doichain allows at most {max} bytes.
errors.taken: The name "{name}" is already registered to the address {address}.
errors.takenUntil: The name "{name}" belongs to the address {address} until block {expiresAt}, {blocksLeft} blocks from now.
errors.pending: The name "{name}" is just being registered to the address {address}; the transaction is not in a block yet.

warnings.nonAscii: This name contains characters beyond ASCII. On chain it is stored as the bytes {hex}; names that look the same can consist of different bytes.
warnings.mixedScripts: This name mixes alphabets, for example Latin and Cyrillic letters that look alike. On chain it is stored as the bytes {hex}.

funds.insufficient: The funds on {address} are not enough for this Doichain name.
funds.insufficientForTransaction: The funds on {address} are not enough to build the transaction for this name.
funds.tooFragmented: The coins on {address} are split into too many small amounts: this would need more than {max} of them. Send them to yourself in DoiWallet to combine them, then try again.

address.label: Doichain registration address
address.scan: Scan the QR code of an address
address.total: Balance: {amount} DOI, coins locked in names included

errors.invalid: This is not a valid Doichain address.
errors.lookupFailed: Could not read the coins of {address}: {error}

features.title: Features:
features.static: Static web app, no server of its own
features.noKeys: No private key in the browser
features.serversSee: The ElectrumX servers see the addresses you enter
features.transfer: Scan the PSBT QR code or copy and paste the PSBT
features.marketplace: Create offers on the marketplace (coming soon)

fees.heading: Register a Doichain name for 36,000 blocks (about 250 days)
fees.summary: You pay {fee} DOI mining fee. {locked} DOI stay locked in the name output, which belongs to you, and {change} DOI come back to you as change.
fees.dust: The {amount} DOI left over are too little for a change output and go to the miners.
fees.details: {rate} swartz per vbyte for about {vsize} vbytes, using {used} of {available} coins.

psbt.label: PSBT (Base64)

steps.scan: Scan the QR code with DoiWallet, or copy the PSBT below.
steps.check: Check the outputs in your wallet: {locked} DOI with the name and {change} DOI change go to {address}.
steps.send: Sign and send only if every output is what you expect.

errors.nameScript: No transaction was built, the name output failed: {error}
errors.prevout: No transaction was built: the server sent data for {txid} that does not match that transaction.
errors.nameInput: No transaction was built: output {txid}:{n} holds a name and cannot pay for a registration.

psbt.copyFailed: Copying failed; select the text below instead.

trade.heading: Buy this name
trade.intro: One transaction pays the price to the current owner {seller} and moves the name to your address. You sign your coins, then the owner signs the name input – so either both happen or nothing does.
trade.sellOfferOff: Sell offers are switched off for now: DoiWallet signs only with SIGHASH_ALL, and an offer signed that way cannot be completed by a buyer.
trade.segwitName: This name is held by a SegWit address ({address}). DoiWallet 7.0.4 cannot yet sign a name input at such an address – tested on regtest –, so the owner could not complete the purchase with DoiWallet.
trade.fundingLabel: Your Doichain address: it pays for the name and receives it
trade.fundingScan: Scan the QR code of the funding address
trade.fundingTotal: Spendable balance of your address: {amount} DOI, without the coins locked in names
trade.fundingInvalid: The funding address has no usable UTXOs.
trade.summary: You pay {price} DOI to {seller} and {fee} DOI mining fee. The name moves to {buyer} with {locked} DOI locked in it, and {change} DOI come back to you as change.
trade.surplus: The name output holds {surplus} DOI more than the locked amount; they go back to the seller.

steps.scan: Scan the QR code with DoiWallet and sign your inputs.
steps.check: Check before signing: {price} DOI go to {seller}; the name and {change} DOI change go to {buyer}.
steps.handOver: Hand the signed PSBT to the owner, who signs the name input and sends the transaction.

errors.price: Enter the price in DOI, for example 1.5.
errors.priceTooLow: The seller would receive less than {minimum} DOI, too little for an output.
errors.ownName: This name already belongs to {address}; there is nothing to buy.
errors.nameOperation: This name was last written with another operation than name_doi. Lesson 5 only trades names written with name_doi.
errors.nameMismatch: The output the server named as holder does not hold "{name}".
errors.unconfirmed: The name is not in a block yet; it can be traded once its transaction is confirmed.
errors.insufficient: The coins on {address} do not cover price and mining fee.

scan.title: Scan a QR code
scan.tip: Hold a QR code in front of your camera.

errors.denied: The browser may not use the camera. Allow it in the site settings, or paste the address below.
errors.missing: No camera found. Paste the address below instead.
errors.unavailable: The camera cannot be used here; browsers allow it only on HTTPS pages. Paste the address below instead.
